headline: DMW Confirms 39 Filipino Seafarers Safe After Black Sea Drone Attacks
seoTitle: 39 Filipino Seafarers Safe After Black Sea Drone Attacks | FMB News
seoDescription: The Department of Migrant Workers confirmed 39 Filipino seafarers aboard two vessels are safe after drone attacks near Novorossiysk in the Black Sea.
deck: Seventeen Filipino crew members of M/V Anna S and 22 aboard M/V Elina B were reported safe as the DMW continued monitoring assistance and repatriation arrangements.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Migrant Workers confirmed that 39 Filipino seafarers aboard two commercial vessels affected by drone attacks near Novorossiysk, Russia, are safe and accounted for.

The total includes 17 Filipino crew members of M/V Anna S and 22 aboard M/V Elina B. The Elina B had assisted the Anna S crew after an earlier incident, and its own crew was later reported safe and unharmed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: One Filipino crew member from M/V Anna S is receiving hospital care in Turkey for a kidney condition unrelated to the drone attack and was reported in stable condition.

The DMW has been coordinating with licensed manning agencies, shipowners and Philippine diplomatic posts as it continues welfare monitoring and repatriation support for Filipino seafarers affected by attacks in the northern Black Sea.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The northern Black Sea remains a high-risk operating environment for commercial shipping. The DMW has maintained restrictions and protective measures for Filipino seafarers assigned to routes exposed to armed conflict.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for DMW updates on repatriation arrangements, medical assistance and any further safety directives for licensed manning agencies and Filipino crews operating near conflict-affected waters.
